sentences.text: Lab Report: Text classification with neural networks
In this report we compare several models on standard benchmarks.
The dataset was split into 70 percent training data and the rest for testing.
All experiments were run on a single GPU with 24 GB of memory.
Figure 1 shows the validation accuracy by dataset.
On CIFAR-10, MLP obtains a validation accuracy of 95.9%.
On IMDB, VGG-16 obtains a validation accuracy of 74%.
MLP outperforms EfficientNet by 7.7 percentage points on SVHN.
On IMDB, VGG-16 is 4.6 points better than MLP.
Figure 2 shows the accuracy of ResNet-50 by dataset.
ResNet-50 scores 25.6 points higher on AG News than on IMDB.
As shown in Figure 2, on AG News, ResNet-50 obtains a accuracy of over 80%.
On SST-2, XGBoost obtains an accuracy of 90.8%.
The differences between the models are discussed in the next section.
